$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

implement.worktreeDir.does: Where ticket and subtask worktrees go, relative to the repository root (`{repo}` is the checkout's folder name).

implement.branchPrefix.does: The prefix of a ticket's branch name (subtasks: `<prefix><key>--<id>`).

implement.delivery.does: How an epic run delivers: one PR for the epic, or one per ticket.

implement.epic.branchPrefix.does: The prefix of an epic's branch name.

implement.epic.bugfixPrefix.does: The prefix of a bug group's branch name.

implement.epic.grouping.does: How an epic's tickets are grouped into pull requests.

implement.epic.featureVerification.does: Runs test planning and test writing for an epic's tickets.

implement.epic.prSplit.does: How a feature epic is split into pull requests.

implement.maxSubtasks.does: The most subtasks a plan may have.

implement.selfModeMaxFiles.does: Guidance for the planner: implement the ticket itself up to about this many files.

implement.maxConcurrentPairs.does: The most verifier pairs of one ticket running at once.

implement.maxConcurrentAgents.does: The most agents running at once on the machine.

implement.maxTakeovers.does: How many times the orchestrator may take over a subtask its pair could not finish.

implement.maxAgentRunsPerStory.does: The most agent runs one ticket may use.

implement.storyWallClockSec.does: The longest one ticket's implementation may take.

implement.prepareCmd.does: A shell command run in each new ticket and subtask worktree (a failure is logged, not fatal).

implement.checks.does: Shell commands (`{ name, cmd }`) run in the worktree after every pair round; a failure fails the round.

implement.checks[].name.does: A check's name in the verifiers' report.

implement.unitTests.cmd.does: The unit test command, with `{project}` (a service's `unitTests` path) and `{service}` (its name).

implement.uiStory.titleTags.does: Title tags that make a ticket a UI ticket.

implement.uiStory.components.does: Ticket components that make a ticket a UI ticket (`null`: the project model's frontend services).

implement.pathHints.roots.does: More top-level folders the harness recognises as repository paths in an implementer's blocked reason.

implement.pathHints.extensions.does: More file extensions the harness recognises as repository paths in an implementer's blocked reason.

implement.requeue.envKeys.does: Extra environment variables `factory requeue-schedule install` copies into the timer.

implement.ui.slotsCmd.does: The command of the stack slot registry UI verifiers lease a slot from.

implement.ui.teststackCmd.does: How a UI verifier starts the app on its slot.

implement.ui.leaseWaitSec.does: How long a UI verifier waits for a free stack slot.

implement.ui.leaseRetrySec.does: How often a UI verifier asks again for a slot.

implement.ui.stackTimeoutSec.does: How long starting the app on a slot may take.

implement.ui.screenshotsDir.does: Where UI verifiers save their screenshots.

implement.ui.renewEverySec.does: How often a held stack slot lease is renewed.

implement.ui.artifactDirs.does: The folders a UI verifier may write into (screenshots, recordings, test reports).

implement.decisions.smallDiffLoc.does: A subtask approved in round 1 at or under this many lines is labelled over-provisioned in the decision report.

implement.decisions.tinySubtaskLoc.does: A subtask at or under this many lines counts as tiny for the should-have-been-self label.

implement.decisions.tinySubtaskFiles.does: A subtask at or under this many files counts as tiny for the should-have-been-self label.

implement.decisions.selfMaxTotalLoc.does: A plan of tiny subtasks at or under this many lines in total should have been done by the orchestrator itself.

implement.decisions.selfOverheadRunsPerS.does: More agent runs than this per tiny subtask mark the plan should-have-been-self.

implement.reviewGate.enabled.does: Runs the review gate that rates bug-fix PRs and decides approvals and auto-merge.

implement.reviewGate.timeoutSec.does: The normal time the bug-triage agent may take.

implement.reviewGate.maxDiffChars.does: The most characters of a PR's diff the bug-triage agent reads.

implement.reviewGate.systems.does: The systems a PR can touch, by path (`name`, `paths`, `shared`, `contract`), for the review gate's ratings (`null`: the project model's services).

implement.reviewGate.sharedPaths.does: Shared systems by name (build files, linked shared sources) added to the project model's services.

implement.reviewGate.contractPaths.does: Contract systems by name (integration events, API contracts) added to the project model's services.

implement.reviewGate.ignore.does: Files the review gate leaves out of a PR's change.

implement.reviewGate.ci.does: How the review gate reads CI on a PR's head (expected and ignored pipelines).

implement.reviewGate.enforced.does: Whether a repository admin lets `factory review-gate enforce` require review quorum and the CI checks (doctor warns until it is done).

implement.reviewGate.requiredChecks.does: The checks `factory review-gate enforce` requires on the default branch (`null`: the factory's CI jobs).

implement.reviewGate.floor.paths.does: Sensitive paths (CI files, CODEOWNERS, the factory's settings) that put a PR at the floor level.

implement.reviewGate.floor.categories.does: Sensitive categories (auth, payments, ...) that put a PR at the floor level.

implement.reviewGate.manySystems.does: A PR that touches at least this many systems is rated one level higher.

implement.reviewGate.confidence.agentWei.does: How much the triage agent's own confidence weighs in the confidence score.

implement.reviewGate.approvals.<level>.does: How many human approvals a PR at each risk level (`Low` to `Severe`, or `default`) needs.

implement.reviewGate.labels.approvals.does: The label that tells reviewers how many approvals a PR needs (`{n}`).

implement.reviewGate.labels.needsHuman.does: The label of a PR a person must decide.

implement.reviewGate.labels.autoMerged.does: The label of a PR the gate merged by itself.

implement.reviewGate.labels.mergeFailed.does: The label of a PR whose automatic merge failed.

implement.reviewGate.labels.reopened.does: The label of a ticket reopened after its PR merged.

implement.reviewGate.substantiveCommentC.does: A review comment at least this long counts as substantive for the gate's records.

implement.reviewGate.retro.minSample.does: The fewest PRs the review gate's retro needs before it proposes a change to a level.

implement.reviewGate.retro.raiseFindRate.does: A level whose reviews find problems at this rate or more is proposed for raising.

implement.reviewGate.retro.raiseEscapeRa.does: A level whose merged PRs let bugs escape at this rate or more is proposed for raising.

implement.reviewGate.retro.lowerFindRate.does: A level whose reviews find problems at this rate or less is proposed for lowering.

implement.autoMerge.enabled.does: Lets the review gate merge a Low-risk, high-confidence bug fix by itself once its CI is green.

implement.autoMerge.identity.does: Who merges: the developer's login, the pipeline's PR bot, or an app or token with a rule bypass.

implement.autoMerge.method.does: How an auto-merged PR is merged.

implement.autoMerge.appTokenEnv.does: The environment variable holding the token of the `app` merge identity.

implement.preOpen.branches.does: Branch patterns whose pushes run CI before a PR exists (`null`: from the branch prefixes).

implement.preOpen.afterOpen.does: How an open PR is held while agents work on it again.

implement.preOpen.wipLabel.does: The blocking label of a held PR (`label` mode).

resources.reserveGb.does: Memory kept free for the rest of the machine when sizing parallel runs.

resources.worktreeGb.does: Memory one ticket's worktree is counted at.

resources.agentGb.does: Memory one agent is counted at.

resources.lspServerGb.does: Memory one language server is counted at.

resources.stackGb.does: Memory one app stack copy is counted at.

resources.dockerOverheadGb.does: Memory Docker itself is counted at.

resources.waitPollSec.does: How often a run waiting for memory checks again.

resources.maxWaitSec.does: How long a run waits for memory before it starts anyway.

implement.ci.maxFixRounds.does: How many times agents try to fix CI failures on a ticket (or an epic group), counting every round: CI's checks run here before the push and before the PR, the branch's CI before the PR, and the PR's CI after it opens; a round counts in the run record when it starts, so a resumed run never gets more. Then a person decides (`0`: a person decides at once).

implement.worker.maxRetries.does: How many times a ticket whose run failed is started again.

implement.worker.retryDelaySec.does: How long to wait before a failed ticket's first retry; the wait doubles each time.

implement.maxOrchestratorRuns.does: The most times the orchestrator may run on one ticket after the subtasks are done (integration, review fixes, bug fixes, PR check fixes); when reached, the ticket stops unresolved.

implement.maxBugFixReturns.does: How many times bugs found by the automated tests are sent back to the implementer before the ticket escalates.

implement.epic.maxTicketsPerGroup.does: The most tickets in one pull request when an epic is split into several PRs (`null`: no limit).

implement.maxParallel.does: The most tickets worked on at the same time: an upper limit on the number worked out from free memory (`null`: no limit; `--parallel N` forces N).

implement.reviewGate.confidence.implemen.does: A bug fix counts toward high confidence only if its implementation checks passed within this many rounds.

implement.reviewGate.confidence.prCheckR.does: A bug fix counts toward high confidence only if the PR check passed within this many rounds.

implement.reviewGate.confidence.highMinS.does: The confidence score out of 100 a bug fix needs to count as high confidence.

implement.reviewGate.floor.minLevel.does: The lowest risk level a PR gets when it touches the floor's paths or categories.

implement.reviewGate.floor.sharedMinLeve.does: The lowest risk level a PR gets when it changes shared infrastructure or a contract between services.

implement.waitSec.prCheck.does: How long a ticket or epic run waits for a PR check to finish before the ticket ends with an incomplete PR check.

implement.waitSec.prCheckStart.does: How long a run waits for the automatic PR check to start at all before treating it as not done.

implement.waitSec.featureVerification.does: How long a run waits for test planning and test writing to finish.

implement.pollSec.featureVerification.does: How often a run checks whether test planning and test writing have finished.

implement.ci.wait.timeoutSec.does: How long a run waits for CI results on a PR.

implement.ci.wait.pollSec.does: How often a run checks CI results.

implement.ci.wait.settleSec.does: How long CI must stay quiet before its result counts as final.

implement.timeoutsSec.planner.does: The normal time the planner may take.

implement.timeoutsSec.orchestrator.does: The normal time the orchestrator may take.

implement.timeoutsSec.pairImplementer.does: The normal time a subtask implementer may take.

implement.timeoutsSec.pairVerifier.does: The normal time a pair verifier may take.

implement.timeoutsSec.pairUiVerifier.does: The normal time a pair UI verifier may take.

implement.timeoutsSec.checks.does: The normal time the build checks after a pair round may take.

implement.timeoutsSec.orchestratorFix.does: The normal time one run of the main implementer may take after the subtasks.

implement.timeoutsSec.epicPlanner.does: The normal time the agent that plans an epic may take.

implement.requeue.outageCooldownSec.does: How long tickets stay paused after the AI provider was unavailable before they are queued again.

implement.ci.wait.enabled.does: Waits for CI before and after a PR opens (off: the PR says CI was not proven).

implement.ci.parity.enabled.does: Runs CI's own checks locally before pushing.

implement.autoMerge.hostAutoMerge.enable.does: Lets the code host's own auto-merge finish an approved PR; off means the pipeline merges it after re-checking the final commit.

implement.maxCouncilRounds.does: How many rounds the pair verifier (and pair UI verifier) council gets before the stage escalates to a person (any council size).

implement.councilPassScore.does: The score every blocking member of the pair verifier (and pair UI verifier) council must give, with no blocking finding standing, for it to pass (any council size).

implement.councilMembers.does: How many counted members sit on the pair verifier and pair UI verifier councils, beside the fixed clean-code seat (`null`: `council.members`).

implement.orchestrator.model.does: The `models.pool` entry the implement stage (the implementer agent: it implements the ticket itself or plans subtasks for pairs) orchestrator runs on (`null`: `orchestrator.model`).

implement.orchestrator.effort.does: The implement stage orchestrator's reasoning effort (`null`: `orchestrator.effort`, else its entry's).

implement.subtaskModels.does: The `models.pool` entries the planner may give a subtask's pair implementer; it names one per subtask (`null`: every entry).

implement.councilIntercom.does: The pair verifiers' council's own discussion settings, over `council.intercom` (a council of one holds no discussion).
